name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
steps: Start in a forearm plank on the floor with your palms flat, elbows positioned slightly ahead of your shoulders, and feet hip-width apart.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly so your body stays straight from head to heels.
Press firmly through both palms to straighten your elbows simultaneously and lift your forearms off the floor.
Lower both elbows smoothly together until your forearms settle gently back onto the floor.
tips: Keep your hips level and prevent your lower back from sagging throughout the press.
Use your knees for support if you cannot lift both forearms together without bending at the hips.
